# WasterVisual

**WasterVisual** is an advanced, premium-tier client-side mod for Minecraft that completely overhauls the game's user interface, HUD, and PvP visual indicators. Built with a modern aesthetic in mind, its core feature is a stunning **Glassmorphism** design language (frosted glass with real-time blur) and unparalleled interface customization.

---

## Compatibility
> **CRITICAL INFO:** WasterVisual utilizes complex, highly customized core shaders to render the frosted glass and blur effects. Because of this, the mod has **severe compatibility issues with third-party shaderpacks (Iris, Oculus, OptiFine)**. 
> To experience the intended visuals and avoid rendering artifacts, it is **strongly recommended to run this mod on the vanilla graphics engine** without external shaders enabled.

---

## Features

### GUI & Customization
* **Liquid Glass Screen:** An incredibly smooth, modern configuration menu that feels like an OS from the future.
* **Full Drag & Drop HUD:** Don't like where the hotbar or armor status is? Just open the menu and move any interface element anywhere on your screen using your mouse in real time!

### HUD Enhancements
* **Player Card (System Media Player):** A native in-game widget that displays what is currently playing on your PC (Spotify, browser players, etc.). It automatically fetches the track title, artist, and album art. Fully compatible with both **Windows** and **Linux**!
* **Dynamic Island:** An iOS-inspired dynamic notification bar that smoothly expands to show game events and statuses.
* **Glass Hotbar & Inventory:** Replaces the boring vanilla containers with sleek, translucent glass panels. Supports vertical hotbar layouts!
* **User Indicator:** A clean widget showing your real-time FPS, Ping (ms), and CPS (Clicks Per Second).

### PvP Indicators
* **Attack Range ESP:** A smart 3-block reach indicator drawn around targets. Supports custom fills, glow effects, and a unique animated "Clock/Gear" rotation effect.
* **BedWars ESP:** Optimized for competitive mini-games. Highlights hitboxes, displays teammate health hearts, and automatically filters out spectators (the white team).
* **Drop Predictor:** Draws highly accurate motion and fall trajectories for yourself and other entities.
* **Ghost Trail (Afterimage):** Leaves a beautiful, customizable RGB/colored phantom trail behind moving players.
* **Custom Hit Stars:** Replaces vanilla critical hit particles with fully adjustable flying stars.

### Rendering Tweaks
* **Custom Hand & Swing:** Complete control over your viewmodel. Change hand position (X, Y, Z), size, tilt, and use unique swing animations (Down, Up, Center).
* **Color Grading & Stretch Res:** Tweak saturation, contrast, or stretch your resolution horizontally/vertically directly in-game without touching monitor settings.

 ---

## Requirements

* **Game Version:** Minecraft `1.20.1` or `1.21.1` *(Note: Not compatible with 1.21.2+ due to Mojang's massive rendering engine changes).*
* **Mod Loader:** Fabric Loader (or Quilt).
* **Required Libraries:** `Fabric API` and `owo-lib` (essential for the configuration interface).
